messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: stripe.webhooks.errors > 5% (5m avg). channel=#payments, severity=high. Root cause suspected: webhook delivery 429 / 403 errors. paging oncall: Alex M.
Alex M: on it. pinging payments and infra. any customer-facing impact yet?
Maya P: seeing webhook acks dropping ~20% for last 8m. our delivery service is getting 429s from stripe (rate_limit). example response in logs: `{"error": {"type":"rate_limit","message":"Too many requests to Stripe's webhooks endpoint"}}`.
Jordan K: I also see a batch of webhook retries failing with 429 and then 410-ish in logs. Delivery queue is backing up. Systems marking some customers as "not able to charge" because invoice.webhook not acknowledged.
Sam O: Support reports 3 customers already raising incidents — payments not processed, retries failing. Are we hitting our webhook concurrency cap or is Stripe returning account-limited?
Maya P: digging — some responses include header `Stripe-Account-Status: limited` and body with `{"error":"account_disabled","message":"Your Stripe account is in limited mode"}`. Not all requests have that header, but it appears mixed.
Lia (payments-bot): FYI: automated retry policy triggered. We're currently at retry 3 for 600 webhooks. Queue depth: 14k. Backoff applied.
Patrick R: If Stripe put the account into limited mode (billing/overdue), webhooks can be disabled. That would explain mixed 429/403/410. Who has Stripe account contact?
Support Oncall: I've opened ticket with customer success to contact the affected customers and requested billing team to check if recent invoice failures correlate.
Alex M: Mitigation plan: 1) enable webhook->polling fallback for critical customers, 2) throttle incoming webhook processing to avoid client-side retries amplifying the problem, 3) open support ticket with Stripe and request urgent review of account status.
Jordan K: Implementing temporary polling: switch stripe-listener into poll mode for specific customer webhook IDs. Command to start polling (dry run):
```
./stripe-listener --mode=poll --customers=\"cust_ABC,cust_DEF\" --since=\"2024-11-02T18:00:00Z\"
```
This will fetch events via API and ack them locally. Expect ~3s per customer request under current token quotas.
Maya P: Executing polling for the top 10 affected customers now. Creating a queue of missed events into payments-processor with `source=manual-poll`.
Sam O: Also flipping a feature flag to reduce retry aggressiveness for webhook delivery to reduce traffic to Stripe while we investigate: `feature.webhook_retry_aggressiveness=low` (patched on prod in 2m).
Lia (payments-bot): Note: switching to polling will increase API token usage. We have a rate-limit of X req/min per API key. We'll need to spread across keys and regions. Suggest using the dedicated token rotation script.
Alex M: Good call. Jordan, coordinate with infra to rotate tokens and shard polling across keys.
Jordan K: Starting token rotation and region-shard now. Using keys: sk_live_xxx1, sk_live_xxx2. Spreading requests with jitter.
Patrick R: Support: prepare a CX note template: short explanation + workaround (poll fallback enabled, processing backlog, ETA for flush). Keep it conservative.
Support Oncall: Drafting now: "We are processing missed Stripe events via a temporary polling fallback. This may cause short delays in invoice updates; no data loss expected. We will update when Stripe confirms webhook delivery restoration."
Alex M: Stripe contact update: Payments team — has anyone confirmed if Stripe flagged the account for unpaid invoices?
Maya P: Payments team says there's an overdue statement on the platform account; Stripe applied a limited mode to the account which disables webhooks. They are escalating with Stripe billing. Ticket ID: STR-4521.
Sam O: Consequence: any customers whose invoices rely only on webhook-driven flows (no polling fallback in their integration) may see delayed invoice acknowledgement and possible entitlement lapses. We should proactively mark those customers and apply temporary grace in entitlement checks.
Patrick R: I'm toggling entitlement grace for affected customer IDs to avoid automated pauses while we catch up. Doing batch update: `PATCH /entitlements/batch` with list. Will record audit.
Jordan K: Backfill progress: polled events queued = 1.2k / expected 9k. Estimated flush time ~ 55m at current rate unless we parallelize more.
Maya P: Also seeing some 401s for a subset of webhook deliveries — likely token rotations on client side. We should ignore client 401s for now and focus on Stripe-side 429/limited.
Alex M: Next actions: - Payments: keep escalation with Stripe billing (Patrick + Maya) - Infra: spread polling keys, monitor API usage (Jordan) - Support: customer comms + entitlement grace (Support Oncall + Patrick) - Oncall handoff: I'm tied up, handing to Jordan at 1890123800 for the next 60m. If Stripe confirms account reinstated, we will re-enable webhook mode and reconcile duplicates.
incident-bot: On-call handoff recorded: from Alex M to Jordan K at 1890123800.
Jordan K: taking over. Will report status every 15m. First checkpoint in 15m.
Maya P: Payment escalation update: Stripe billing acknowledged ticket STR-4521 and asked for latest failed invoice list; sent over 09:54 PT. They marked it high priority.
Support Oncall: Sent customer outbound to 4 affected enterprise customers with instructions and note that we're applying temporary grace. No public status page update yet — recommend we post a short status once we have confirmation from Stripe.
Patrick R: Applying entitlement grace... batch applied for 47 customers. Audit id: ent-grace-1890123478.
Jordan K: Polling backfill: polled 3.8k events now. Queue reduced to 5.2k. CPU spike observed on payments-processor; autoscale triggered additional workers. Monitoring backlog and error rate.
Maya P: Stripe responded to escalation: they're processing account billing review, expected update in ~45-60m. They can re-enable webhooks once the billing hold is cleared.
Sam O: Once Stripe flips, we need a coordinated cutover: 1) stop poll mode, 2) drain processed events dedup logic, 3) re-enable webhook delivery consumers. I'll prepare a runbook steps and a canary customer list.
Jordan K: Noted. Preparing canary list and runbook.
Alex M: Thanks team. Keep updates compact. If any customer escalates to SLO breach, tag #exec-incident.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated -> mitigations in progress. Tags: payments, third_party/stripe, webhook_fallback, entitlement_grace.
Jordan K: 1890124099 — checkpoint: polled 6.5k/9k events, Stripe billing still in review. Backlog expected to clear in ~25-30m at current parallelism. Continuing to monitor.
